statements: INV-034: exactly one ExpenseDocument per Expense regardless of allocation count; the binary stays outside the record
verdicts.why: The accepted two-allocation intake is checked to persist one Expense and one ExpenseDocument containing a file reference. This is only one allocation-count scenario, and the check does not directly establish that binary content stays outside the record.

statements: INV-032: the sum of an expense's allocations equals its total_amount at every commit point; amount correction and allocation adjustment are one atomic operation
INV-035: only confirmed expenses with included=true participate in financial totals; excluded expenses remain visible
INV-036: allocation targets and progress sections belong to the expense's/project's own project; cross-project references are rejected
verdicts.why: The intake run rejects allocation-shape and cross-project-section violations without mutation, and verifies an accepted allocation sum, partially covering INV-032 and INV-036.
